rootCause: Dual ML Pipeline Disconnect: A prototype/stub service in ml/ (which executed ml/predict.py against empty ml/artifacts/) was wired into areaIntelligenceController and dashboardIntelligenceController, bypassing the fully-trained, operational XGBoost production pipeline in data/ml/ and managed by mlPredictionService.js.

Sentinel-2 ImageServer Latency vs Timeout: The ArcGIS Living Atlas image server takes 3.4s-5.5s to respond from India. The previous 5000ms timeout caused ECONNABORTED network timeouts under slight latency jitter.

Omission of Top-Level satelliteEvidence: While satelliteLandCover was queried, areaIntelligenceController did not expose satelliteEvidence as a top-level key in the API response, causing fallback checks to report unavailable.
Server Process In-Memory State: The npm start background server was running continuously for over 3 hours and had not reloaded active controller modifications.
fixesApplied: Wired mlPredictionService.predictSusceptibility into areaIntelligenceController.js and dashboardIntelligenceController.js, preserving unit test mock compatibility.
Made BASE_DIR dynamic in data/ml/train_xgboost_models.py to prevent hardcoded directory assumptions.
Exposed satelliteEvidence as a top-level property in areaIntelligenceController.js response payload.
Updated AreaIntelligencePanel.jsx to display rich operational states (susceptibility probability, categorical risk, trigger status) while maintaining strict test compatibility.
Verified live end-to-end API execution: verified 0 limitations, mlPrediction: true, and satellite: true on coordinates (27.33, 88.61).
remainingIssues: Active Terminal Restart Required: The user or terminal manager must restart the background 'npm start' process so Node reloads the updated controller files into active memory.

Multi-Scale Antecedent Rainfall for Dynamic Trigger: Real-time point queries currently skip the dynamic trigger model safely because 3d/7d/30d historical precipitation is only fetched during historical backfills; static susceptibility runs at 100% operational capacity.
